loads_b_r9_state_definition.rule: loaded AS-IS; the formal state definition is NEVER modified in B-R10

formal_boundaries_under_audit.note: all four remain UNCHANGED; B-R10 only measures around them

penetration_definition_diagnostic.penetration_ratio: penetration_distance / ATR20 at the same bar
penetration_definition_diagnostic.penetration_distance: max(high - level_price, level_price - low) while in the touch band
penetration_definition_diagnostic.event_level_value: MAX over the band episode (primary), plus the ENTER-bar value (secondary)
penetration_definition_diagnostic.SAMPLE_SCOPE: ALL touch events (never only the already-labelled PENETRATION subset) - task 10
penetration_definition_diagnostic.selection_bias_guard: the continuous statistic is recomputed from the raw band geometry for every touch event

separation_criteria_preregistered.bimodality_rule: NATURAL_SEPARATION only if two local maxima exist, are >= 0.15 ATR apart, each carries >= 5% of the sample mass, and a separating local minimum has density <= 0.5 x min(peak_left, peak_right)
separation_criteria_preregistered.no_separation_rule: NO_NATURAL_SEPARATION if the density is unimodal or monotonically non-increasing over the support

first_touch_sparsity_test.method: SHADOW_BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION: re-run the frozen lifecycle with ONLY the penetration gate replaced by each pre-registered reference point
first_touch_sparsity_test.report: FIRST_TOUCH / REPEATED_TOUCH / PENETRATION counts per shadow boundary
first_touch_sparsity_test.forbidden: choosing any shadow boundary as a formal rule

reclaim_audit.FORMAL_RECLAIM: count produced by the frozen rule (RECLAIM_WINDOW_BARS=8)
reclaim_audit.DIAGNOSTIC_RECLAIM_REACHABILITY: for each BREAK_CONFIRMED run, whether the close EVER returns to the original side afterwards (unbounded horizon) and within 1/2/3/5/8 bars
reclaim_audit.note: diagnostic reachability never enters the formal state machine

ambiguity_categories.A: same timestamp genuinely satisfies two structural states (intrinsic)
ambiguity_categories.F: implementation problem (B10 script only; ENGINE_PY untouched)

lookahead_rule: S(t) uses only data <= t; S(t+1) may be used ONLY as a post-hoc transition label
null_shuffle_purpose: sanity only; never used to pick a boundary
